The '''Quell system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]],<ref name="teaoc" /> located in the northern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SW-Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quell/Legends|Quell]],<ref name="planetrant" /> a world of strategic importance.<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Jedi Crash Date">{{TCWdates|113}}</ref> as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Sky Battle of Quell|battle]] took place between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> in the highest levels of the Quell's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="DB-Quell">{{DB|location|quell|Quell}}</ref> The engagement ended with the eradication of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]],<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> and a Separatist victory.<ref name="Planets in Peril">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref>
